BACKGROUND: | BACKGROUND: | BACKGROUND: | BACKGROUND: | BACKGROUND:
This resolution is to order the General Election to be held on May 1, 2021 to elect three City Council members, the Mayor, Place 1 and Place 2, to be filled for three years or until their successors are duly elected and qualified. Pursuant to Section 3.005(c) of the Texas Election Code, a city must order its election no later than the 78th day before Election Day, which this year falls on Friday, February 12, 2021.

Early voting begins Monday, April 19 and runs through Tuesday, April 27.  The main early voting location in Bedford will be the Public Library; however, residents can vote at any Tarrant County early voting location. The early voting schedule is below:

                                   
Election Day is 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Saturday, May 1, 2021. The main election day voting location in Bedford will most likely still be the Pat May Center at 1849B Central Drive; however, residents will be able to vote at any Tarrant County election day location.  
 
A runoff election, if necessary, ensuing from the May 1, 2021 General Election, is tentatively scheduled for June 5, 2021.

As in the past and per state law, staff recommends that this election be held jointly and administered by the Tarrant County Election’s Administration. This has proven to be the most cost effective and efficient way to hold elections.  The exact cost of the election is not known at this time and will depend on how many entities end up contracting with the County.
